package.name: g1_arm_abs
package.description: Absolute arm control with NN-based grasp / elevator-button inference and obstacle-aware voxel A* planning for the Unitree G1 humanoid. A single node (g1_arm_simple) owns NN IK, voxel A* on the head-camera depth stream, per-arm pose compensation, dual-arm home, lift / retract, and hand-service coordination. Consumes g1_camera's GetObjectPosition service for the legacy grasp_bottle path and drives g1_hands Trigger services (pre_grasp, grasp_5f, release, point_gesture) per side.
